mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 6.5% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 6.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, which triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS (both down > 1% from prior month) fails to predict negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.02 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A stagflationary regime characterized by declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL annual change > 2.0%) leads to reduced corporate profitability and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The regime defined by INDPRO < 100 and CPIAUCSL annual change > 2.0% fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the regime condition falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in housing starts (HOUST) above 900,000 units per month indicates robust consumer confidence and strong demand for residential construction, which correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST above 900,000 fails to predict positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.5% signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.5% fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% annually) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), the Federal Reserve faces a policy dilemma that increases market uncertainty, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation and low interest rate regime
failure_condition: The regime of high inflation (CPIAUCSL annual change > 2.5%) and low rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) fails to predict negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the regime condition falls below 0.02 over a 3-year window.
